faq.q: How much does F & G Legal Group charge?
faq.a: F & G Legal Group publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does F & G Legal Group offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. F & G Legal Group publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does F & G Legal Group have offices?
faq.a: F & G Legal Group publishes two offices, among them Staten Island. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at F & G Legal Group?
faq.a: F & G Legal Group names two attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. 1 of 2 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status. 1 could not be told apart from namesakes in the register and are counted neither way.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about F & G Legal Group?
faq.a: F & G Legal Group scores 33 and sits at Verified. Passed: licensure, discipline, website and footprint. Did not pass: entity registration.
